title: Title: Abel and Cain (הבל and קין)
summary: Opening title slide: the presenter, in front of a world map, shrugs with raised hands under the names Abel (with a halo) and Cain (with a devil's pitchfork), each shown in English and Hebrew.

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter, a grey-haired man with glasses and a white Hard Rock Cafe T-shirt, sitting on a couch in front of a large world wall map and shrugging with both hands raised. Overlaid titles: 'Abel' in blue with a gold halo over the A and 'Cain' in green with a red devil's pitchfork, with the Hebrew names below.
